title: Evolution experiment contaminants
description: Metagenome sequences from two samples each of eight populations from a contaminated evolution experiment, originally initiated with Pseudomonas fluorescens SBW25. Experimental environments are M9 salts + glucose agar plates with a solid agar base layer and semi-solid top layer.
samples: MIMS Environmental/Metagenome sample from indoor metagenome

M9 agar plates inoculated with Pseudomonas fluorescens SBW25 with glucose as the sole carbon source; transferred to a fresh agar plate every 24 hours; contaminated from lab environment between day 21 and 28; uniform glucose concentration, experimental population 1, center
